rules.definition: Require exact case, policy identity/version, incident interval, verified sources and pinned specification before policy-dependent evaluation.

Every supplied document must have accepted scan assertions and complete M6 source-replayed evidence admitted to the case. Require claim form, repair estimate and damage image. Claimed and estimated amounts must match.
Only source-linked synthetic human category motor_damage is supported; other is FAIL and unknown or conflicting assertions are INDETERMINATE.
Only reviewed gradual_wear_only (without impact) is an exclusion FAIL. Reviewed impact is PASS; unknown remains INDETERMINATE. Never infer cause from narrative or image.

Only after PR01–PR04 PASS and without ambiguous/conflicting/injection/unsupported flags, illustrate min(max(estimate_pence - excess_pence, 0), limit_pence). All amounts are GBP integer pence. No rounding, selection of conflicting amounts, settlement or payment authority.

Every result requires human review. Any FAIL/INDETERMINATE or risk flag requires a supervisor. Reported claimed amount at or above the version high_value_pence threshold adds high_risk; never removes supplied risk flags.
